findings.detail: SectionLabel uses `margin: 0 0 2px 0` — a raw 2px magic value in a style body. No 2px spacing token exists (theme.spacing.xs is the smallest at 4px). Diff-introduced (new file), copied verbatim from DriverRidePage. Cosmetic label margin, not a color/large-spacing theme bypass.

Local `expanded` state is only ever set to false (Escape -> setExpanded(false)); nothing sets it true, so the sheet is always collapsed and Escape's onClose is a no-op. Consequence: RideSheet.test.tsx test 8 (WI test_case #7 'Escape -> onClose called') is vacuous — the persisted-dialog assertion passes regardless of onClose wiring (the real Escape->onClose lives in BottomSheet, which is unchanged). WI-5 assembly will drive expansion if needed.

onNoShow handler is never exercised — every test uses noShowEnabled=false, so the No-show secondary stays disabled and handleSecondary->onNoShow never fires. WI test_cases did not require it (conformant), but it is a coverage gap for the secondary-action path.
